persistedQueryReceipts.scope: Only public ADS bibliographic metadata is retained. CTAS does not download, mirror, or assert reuse rights for article full text; publisher and repository links retain their own access and reuse terms. Event association requires an exact retained transient name.

Rubin alert packets are world-public with no proprietary period, and Fink documents its LSST Science Portal and REST API as real-time, public services requiring no login. Coordinate and first-detection proximity are not proof of source identity.

WISeREP's official help states that private data require a personal API key for scripted access. CTAS sends no credentials, requests public=yes explicitly, and accepts only rows independently marked public=1 from the anonymous public export.

ZTF alert difference-image PSF photometry; non-detections are retained as upper limits, not forced photometry. Coordinate association does not assert identity. Public ZTF alert photometry served by the ALeRCE broker. Cite Förster et al. (2021), AJ 161, 242, and acknowledge ALeRCE and the Zwicky Transient Facility according to current provider guidance.

parameters.sharedParameters: timing (and the plateau slope s) shared across bands; one amplitude per band

parameters.sharedParameters: timing (and the plateau slope s) shared across bands; one amplitude per band

runs.claimBoundary: A phenomenological fit to public difference and forced photometry; it describes the light-curve shape and is not a classification, a physical model or a distance.

runs.claimBoundary: A distance-dependent estimate from a phenomenological peak; not a calibrated luminosity.

parameters.kCorrection: +2.5 log10(1+z) bandwidth term only; no spectral k-correction

warnings: the absolute magnitude uses a redshift without its uncertainty; peculiar velocity and spectral k-correction are not included

runs.claimBoundary: A brightening relative to the event's own recent detections; not a classification.
A periodogram peak and its false-alarm probability under white noise, after removing the fitted transient; residual structure of an imperfect fit can also produce peaks. Not a classification.

parameters.detrending: magnitudes minus the chosen multiband fit when one exists (a transient's own rise and fall is not a period)
parameters.periodicCandidateRule: FAP < 1e-3, best period shorter than a third of the span, and the frequency not within 0.02 day^-1 of the 1, 2 or 3 day^-1 sampling aliases

runs.claimBoundary: SALT3 light-curve parameters assuming a normal type Ia supernova; not a classification or a distance.

parameters.bands: ZTF g, r, i (ATLAS left out of the SALT3 fit)
parameters.phaseWindowDays: detections from 20 days before to 50 days after the brightest detection, times (1+z) (z = 0.1 when fitted)
parameters.selectionRule: TNS classification containing 'Ia', or a broker reading of SN Ia

runs.claimBoundary: Screens that point at candidates for a closer look (kilonova-like timescales, nuclear position); they are not classifications.
